task: Stop a fork PR from triggering the OpenForge status publisher (and receiving OPENFORGE_STATUS_TOKEN) through a workflow named Release

events.summary: Only the publish job's if: guard changes; inputs, secrets, the pinned reusable workflow and portal-release.yml (tracked in #395) stay unchanged.
The guard accepted any successful workflow_run of a workflow named Release, including a pull_request run from a fork that defines its own Release workflow, so OPENFORGE_STATUS_TOKEN reached that run.
evidence: test:python3 -m unittest scripts/ci/tests/test_publish_openforge_status_guard.py on origin/main -> FAILED (failures=3): no event == 'push', head_repository, or v* tag condition

events.summary: workflow_run path now also requires event == 'push', head_repository == github.repository, and a head_branch starting with v (release.yml only runs on push: tags: v*).
The new guard test passes, the full scripts/ci suite stays green, and actionlint accepts the workflow.
evidence: test:python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/ci/tests -> Ran 118 tests OK

events.summary: Status publisher can only run from a maintainer tag push or a manual dispatch.
Complete and verified within the stated scope
